Stardew Valley first spring watering

Game: Stardew Valley.

In Stardew Valley, water planted parsnip seeds with the watering can each morning when it is not raining. A watered crop advances its growth overnight. Rain waters outdoor crops without spending watering-can energy. Refill the watering can at a pond if it is empty. These basic crop-care steps apply during the first spring on an ordinary farm.
